We'll start you off right, with a ship that's mostly space-worthy and with very few miles. You'll easily pay it off in only a few dozen years.|Rel Keteris|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Rel Keteris''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Rel Keteris flew as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. At one point, he could be found outside the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While there, he encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], and explained the perks of flying for Jabba.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rel Keteris is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, he simply persuades players to become a pilot for Jabba.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' {{1st}}
